report.headline: Arabic landing page live, ad budgets rebalanced, IVR menu updated

done.text: Built and published the Arabic car-accident landing page at maadilaw.com/ar-car-accident-lawyer, with full right-to-left layout, the same call and form tracking as the English pages, and kept out of Google search so it only receives ad traffic.
Updated the phone menu so callers who press nothing hear the menu twice (down from three times) and are then routed to the new-client queue.
Added new creatives to the Arabic instant-form campaign and paused one video ad that was not performing.
Rebalanced daily ad budget: moved $50/day from LSA to Google Ads, leaving LSA at $57/day, to put more spend behind the campaigns showing stronger results.
Re-enabled the Meta Lead ID capture workflow in the CRM so that incoming instant-form leads write their ID to the reporting field.

in_progress.text: Rebuilding the Clio-to-GHL contact sync in Zapier to fix source overwrites and blank contact data, replacing the native plugin so the two systems never write at the same time.

Designing a GHL attribution dashboard showing total leads, opportunity stages and signed cases by source, with drill-downs for Meta and Google, so you can see where leads and cases come from in one place.
Reviewing four CRM tracking gaps identified last week: source mapping on landing-page forms, source-overwrite protection for LSA contacts, and conversion-workflow coverage across ad channels.
Video editing has started on two November ad creatives, with B-roll cutaways ready for use.

waiting_on_you.text: Please review the Arabic copy on the live landing page and either approve it or send us your preferred copy so we can swap it in before running any Arabic search ads.
Please confirm who on your team handles Arabic calls and during which hours, so we know the intake is ready before we pay for Arabic ad clicks.

Please arrange a quick test of the updated phone menu with Tracy during business hours: call your main line from an outside phone, leave the keypad alone, and confirm the menu plays twice before her phone rings.

next_week.text: Continue monitoring LSA and Google Ads performance and adjust the budget split further if the data supports it.
Tighten keywords in the Google Search campaign to reduce wasted spend.
Complete the Clio-to-GHL Zapier rebuild, run a full end-to-end test through the intake workflow, and confirm results.
Once Arabic copy and intake are approved, share the landing page URL with the ads team to launch the Arabic keyword test on Google Search.

internal_flags.text: Fix 4 GHL Tracking Gaps item: the specialist's second post identifies a concrete open issue, that LSA Ads is missing from the source-protection list in the Ad Landing Page Intake workflow. This means an existing LSA contact who submits the landing page with a GCLID can be reclassified as Google Ads. The specialist flagged it and asked lead to add LSA Ads to the guard, but no confirmation was posted. Confirm whether this fix was made before closing the item.

Fix 4 GHL Tracking Gaps item: the specialist's first post questions the lead's description of gap #2, saying the existing settings already protect paid sources correctly. The two posts are not fully reconciled. Review both posts to confirm whether gap #2 is actually resolved or still open before marking the item done.

Attribution Dashboard item: it is blocked on the Clio-to-GHL Zapier rebuild completing first. Also, the ads team has been asked to give the CRM specialist owner access to Meta and Google Ads for the spend-integration check. Confirm that access was granted so the dashboard build is not delayed.

IVR Menu item: the specialist completed the change but asked for a coordinated test with Tracy. No confirmation from Tracy or the reviewer was posted in the window. Chase confirmation so the item can be marked done.
